sources.title: nanochat: Open-Source ChatGPT Alternative for Training Your Own LLM
sources.snippet: Train a small language model, inspect the code behind every major stage, and measure its results against a visible GPT-2 target. nanochat is built for LLM learning and experiments. nanochat is an open-source project for training a small language model from scratch, then talking to the trained model from your own machine.
